_comment: ★ THE ONLY hand-editable source of truth for every distribution artifact (Vercel / Dify / n8n). Everything under generated/ is produced from this file plus tools.json. Never edit generated/ by hand.
_distributionRepoComment: The public repo that HOSTS AND PUBLISHES the distribution artifacts. n8n verification checks that the repository URL on npm matches the real GitHub repo, so package.json must point here, not at the MCP kit repo.
_pricingComment: ★★ NO PRICE LIVES HERE, AND NO PRICE MAY EVER BE COPIED INTO generated/. The price exists only in the live 402 challenge. Every artifact must read it at runtime. That is the whole point: an artifact that contains no price cannot quote a wrong price. See docs/技術坑與策略.md §1.55.
_chainFactsComment: For the LIVE PROBE (gate C) only - assert the production challenge still looks like this. NOT for embedding in artifacts; artifacts read payTo/asset/amount from the challenge itself.
disclosure: Truth Bear is an external paid service. The free tools (verify_citation, find_signal) need no wallet and no API key. The paid tool returns an x402 payment challenge; this artifact surfaces that challenge as data and never holds, requests, or transacts a private key.
